newsitem.title: UK: OLYMPICS-BRITISH ATHLETES TO GET FUNDING - NEWSPAPER REPORT.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-BRITISH ATHLETES TO GET FUNDING - NEWSPAPER REPORT.

text.p: British Olympic hopefuls could be paid tax-free salaries up to 28,000 pounds sterling ($46,150) a year from a National Lottery fund, the Observer newspaper reported on Sunday.
The front-page report said the new funding was part of an overall grand design for sport which would be completed by setting up a 100 million pounds ($165 million) National Academy.

"The Sports Council will reveal plans on Thursday for a 50 million pounds ($82 million) pot of gold from the National Lottery aimed at creating winner in the international arena, enabling British athletes to compete on an equal footing," the report said.
"It would provide instant cash for elite performers and back-up funding for coaching, travelling equipment and medical treatment."
